title: VoiceUtterance
description: Response of POST /v1/voice/utterance (multipart: `audio` = audio/webm;codecs=opus | audio/wav | audio/ogg, max 15 s and 1 MB; optional `lang_hint` = ar|en). The audio is transcribed on our own machine and discarded; neither audio nor transcript is stored or logged. Wake phrase and intent are deterministic (no LLM). Scope: read.

wake.description: true when the utterance opens with a wake phrase (English: hey/hi/ok falcon, falcon lens; Arabic: يا صقر, عدسة الصقر, ...), tolerant of ASR spelling errors.

intent.description: Read from `command`. Without the wake phrase only a short bare stop word yields `stop`; every other utterance is `none`.

command.description: The part after the wake phrase, empty when there is no wake phrase.

model.description: Engine and model that answered, e.g. `native:whisper-large-v3-turbo` or `container:faster-whisper-small`.
